data.name: Luka
data.gender_notes: Luka is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Luka is recorded in name-lists as “Bright, Shining”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Luka expresses “Bright, Shining”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luka total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: לוקא
in_hebrew.meaning: לוּקָא הוּא שֵׁם שֶׁל מְגִילָה בַּתּוֹרָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לוּקָא שֵׁם שֶׁל מְגִילָה בַּתּוֹרָה, מִתְאָרֵךְ לְגַמָדִים וְלִפְרָשׂוֹת שֶׁל דְּבָרִים הַמְקוֹרִיִּים בְּקִרְבָּנוֹת הָאֱלֹהִים. הוּא קֶשֶׁר לַעֲמוּדָה וְלִפְרָשָׂה שֶׁל הַמְשׁוֹרֵר בַּכְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים.

in_greek.name: Λουκάς
in_greek.meaning: Λουκάς ο ευαγγελιστής και συνοδός του Παύλου
in_greek.long_meaning: Λουκάς σημαίνει 'ο φέγγος' ή 'ο λευκός', συνδέεται με την αποστολή του Ευαγγελιστή Λουκά, συγγραφέα του Ευαγγελίου και των Πραξεων των Αποστόλων, που ήταν σύντροφος του Αποστόλου Παύλου και ιατρός.

in_latin.name: Lucas
in_latin.long_meaning: Lucas nomen derivatur a latino 'lux', quod lucem significat. Lucas in Ecclesia primitiva erat sanctus et evangelista, medicus et scriptor Actuum Apostolorum et Evangelii secundum Lucam.
